content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from zoomtvSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inzoomtvVerified•FollowMore optionszoomtvVerified Edited•1wSean Penn won the Best Supporting Actor award at the 98th Academy Awards for his performance in One Battle After Another. However, the veteran actor did not attend the ceremony to accept the award. While announcing the win, Kieran Culkin noted that Penn could not be present at the event. In the film, Penn plays a seasoned political strategist navigating complex ideological battles and shifting alliances. The performance has been widely praised and stood out among a strong lineup of nominees including Delroy Lindo, Benicio del Toro, Jacob Elordi and Stellan Skarsgård. The win marks Penn’s third Academy Award. He had earlier won Best Actor Oscars for Mystic River and Milk.
